scope: Original instructions, RAM-only routines/case slices; not full firmware or hardware emulation
cadet_boundary_policy: Clock return controlled at 0x0801b374; ordered register_mods/unregister_mods/tap_code intents captured at 0x08013f74/0x08014098/0x08014188. Original global-term lookup executes. No HID reports/delays or automatic dispatcher interruption routing.
cadet_core_scope: Starts at 0x08016646 ONLY; prior feature/vendor gates are not modeled. Default press stops at 0x08017350 after reset; release stops at 0x080174d4 before later handling. Vendor bypass cases start at 0x08015e96 and must return at 0x08015c6e without visiting core/reset. 0x7e0f is excluded.
tap_boundary_policy: Real 0x08014188 wrapper, 0x08014148 delay arithmetic and 64-bit division execute; register_code/unregister_code/sleep_ticks boundaries are recorded and returned from. Expanded cadet cases do not stub tap_code itself. USB reports, scheduler and real waiting remain unexecuted.
settings_reset_boundary_policy: Original 0x080144dc RAM assignments execute through 0x08014524 exclusive. EEPROM save/reset, keyboard clear and callbacks are NOT executed. Byte 35 is deliberately preserved.
dynamic_record_boundary_policy: Only 0x08015880..0x08015916 assignments/loops execute. 0x0801d570 writes are recorded and returned from, never persisted. Earlier keymap/QS reset, unlock changes, callbacks and later relock are excluded; stack guards checked.
prefix_boundary_policy: Original validity checker and two independent startup slices execute. Read-byte/read-word return controlled input; reset entries 0x0801ae2e/0x080143e4 are recorded and returned from BEFORE executing their bodies. No EEPROM/flash/reset operations. Slices do not simulate full boot or the effects of a preceding reset.
snapshot_boundary_policy: Original 0x08018758..0x08018816 load/hash/compare plus RAM-only clear execute. Backing reads return controlled translated bytes; memset is bounded to cache RAM. Data-failure path stops before outer clear at 0x08018896. No checksum-read failures, log playback, physical translation, flash init/erase/program/lock or full startup. Budget 200000 instructions per bounded 4096-byte case.
journal_boundary_policy: One supplied first word, original 0x08018824 decode/copy, stop at 0x0801887e or before 0x08018886 global cursor commit. First-read status, whole-loop playback/consolidation and flash operations NOT executed. Backing second read controlled; memcpy bounded to cache. Lengths 6/7 and second reads beyond backing budget NOT emulated. Initial cache uses ramp pattern.
backing_boundary_policy: RAM-only driver object/vtable/descriptor; program callback captured before first instruction; read physical base redirected to synthetic RAM; final error byte injected after stale clear, NOT a physical fault. Geometry callbacks return original immutable ROM descriptors. No flash init/lock/unlock/erase/program or real bus-fault handling executed.
gpio_startup_boundary_policy: Original 0x0801aa7e leaf writer, GPIO destination redirected to guarded RAM, immutable original table at 0x0801ea14. No physical MMIO, whole early-init or clock procedure executed.
rgb_chunk_boundary_policy: Original limits helper all 256 uint8 inputs; only iter0..4 are normal valid rendering spans. Composed 0x080156ce..0x0801571a active-effect slices at iter0/1/4, state RENDERING except FLUSHING on iter4; host Caps and RGB setters controlled, original limits/filter instructions execute. No full effect engine, scheduler, HID or physical LEDs executed.
rgb_group_boundary_policy: Reset 0x0801441e..0x08014434 before flush captures logical writes only; load 0x08018c84..0x08018c98 supplies complete four-byte read into original zeroed temporary. No EEPROM backend, full reset, flush, partial/failing read, on-toggle persistence or migration executed.
